notes.title: Small update
notes.content:
Hello 

Breaking news 

Fixes: 
Fixed 17, 18 and 38 levels – now these are a little easier. 
Fixed bug with first keeper (20 level) that caused eternal life of his crystal. 
Small bugs fixed. 

Plus: 

Added 4 new achievements – completing levels ending with 5 (5, 15, 25, 35) 
[img]http://savepic.ru/12847490.png[/img] [img]http://savepic.ru/12851586.png[/img] [img]http://savepic.ru/12908933.png[/img] [img]http://savepic.ru/12897669.png[/img]



[b] I am very glad that you loved our game from a pure heart. 

Thank you for your support![/b]
